description: The plot illustrates the relative change in percentage across different layers for various configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and is categorical, with tick labels “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32”. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals.  A dashed gray line, representing “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”, remains steady at approximately 0% across all layers. A solid orange line with circular markers, labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”, starts at approximately 1.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -10% at Layer13-20, then increases to approximately -6% at Layer29-32. A solid blue line with square markers, labeled “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, begins at approximately 1.5% at Layer1-4, declines to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, and rises to approximately -10% at Layer29-32. A solid teal line with circular markers, labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, starts at approximately 2.5% at Layer1-4, decreases to approximately -23% at Layer13-20, and increases to approximately -15% at Layer29-32. Finally, a solid navy line with square markers, labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”, begins at approximately 2.5% at Layer1-4, declines to approximately -18% at Layer13-20, and rises to approximately -12% at Layer29-32.
